gen-dafont-nasalization-gf-faustina: Faustina thins its bowls gently rather than sharply. Nasalization floats its letters apart and draws every join at full width, while Faustina lets each round letter swell slightly, and that gentle give is the draw.
gen-dafont-nasalization-gf-headland-one: Headland One keeps its letters well apart and never crowds. Mild thick-thin shifts smooth the reading pace, so paragraphs of it would glide along, while Nasalization stays plain and flat in line weight.
gen-dafont-nasalization-gf-hedvig-letter: Flat, friendly, floating: Nasalization draws every curve in one plain line, with no swell anywhere. And Hedvig Letters Serif, open-ended and sturdy, would carry paragraphs comfortably, its thins only slightly lighter than its thicks.
gen-dafont-nasalization-gf-montagu-slab: Montagu Slab reads like lightly engraved brass, sturdy downstrokes against slender turns, with a generous x-height. Nasalization does best with friendly, floating display lines, while Montagu Slab does best with sustained reading.
gen-dafont-nasalization-gf-noto-serif-he: Nasalization draws with a ballpoint's plain, pressure-free line, its letters floating well apart. But Noto Serif Hentaigana softens every curve with shifts in thickness that never turn stark, and its small letters nearly reach the capitals.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-domine: Bent-wire glow: Neon's round letters keep one uninterrupted line width. Domine keeps a mid-range gap between its boldest and faintest strokes, with breathing room in every curve, and that moderation is the pair's real strength.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-esteban: Neon keeps one constant pen width throughout, with open spacing between every glyph pair. But Esteban lets a modest gap open between stems and hairlines, and that quiet difference is what holds the pair together.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-halant: Bent tubing, glowing: that is Neon at a glance. Halant brings medium contrast, no sharp hairlines, and a towering x-height, which is the sturdy grounding that makes Neon's glow stand out.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-lisu-bosa: Glowing and vibrant, Neon bends its line like sign wire. Lisu Bosa offers spill-out openings and a faint nib-pressure swell on each round letter, grounding all that glow with editorial weight.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-ovo: Ovo keeps its thins only slightly lighter than its thicks. Its shallow ascenders and spacious curve terminals would make paragraphs feel gentle and steady, while the w in Neon has no thick or thin strokes.
